research_questions.statement: Can DropEdge improve the performance of deep GCNs on node classification?

provenance.text_excerpt: Another valuable observation in Table 1 is that the 32-layer IncepGCN without DropEdge incurs the Out-Of-Memory (OOM) issue while the model with DropEdge survives, showing the advantage of DropEdge to save memory consuming by making the adjacency matrix sparse.

claims.statement: DropEdge saves memory by making the adjacency matrix sparse, preventing OOM issues.

provenance.text_excerpt: The DropEdge based approaches outperform the DropNode based variants as shown in Table 2, which somehow conﬁrms the effectiveness of DropEdge.

claims.statement: DropEdge based approaches outperform DropNode based variants.

provenance.text_excerpt: Figure 4b depicts a comparison between the proposed DropEdge and the layer-wise DropEdge on Citeseer.

claims.statement: The proposed DropEdge outperforms layer-wise DropEdge.

provenance.text_excerpt: The curves along the training epoch are dramatically pulled down after applying DropEdge, which also explains the effect of DropEdge on alleviating over-ﬁtting.

claims.statement: DropEdge helps alleviate over-fitting, as shown by reduced validation losses.

provenance.text_excerpt: For most models with DropEdge, the best accuracy is obtained under the depth beyond 2, which again veriﬁes the impact of DropEdge on formulating deep networks.

claims.statement: For most models with DropEdge, the best accuracy is obtained under depth beyond 2.

provenance.text_excerpt: Figure 7a shows the ablation study of Dropout vs. DropEdge ... on Citeseer.

claims.statement: Combining DropEdge and Dropout yields the best performance.

provenance.text_excerpt: Figure 6 depicts the additional results of validation loss on different backbones w and w/o DropEdge.

claims.statement: DropEdge reduces validation loss across different backbones.

provenance.text_excerpt: It’s observed that DropEdge consistently improves the testing accuracy for all cases.

claims.statement: DropEdge consistently improves the testing accuracy for all cases.

provenance.text_excerpt: Clearly, our DropEdge obtains signiﬁcant enhancement against SOTAs; particularly on Reddit, the best accuracy by our method is 97.02%, and it is better than the previous best by AS-GCN (96.27%), which is regarded as a remarkable boost considering the challenge on this benchmark.

claims.statement: DropEdge obtains significant enhancement against state-of-the-art methods.

provenance.text_excerpt: On Citeseer, for example, DropEdge yields further improvement for deeper architecture; it gains 0.9% average improvement for the model with 2 layers while achieving a remarkable 13.5% increase for the model with 64 layers.

claims.statement: DropEdge yields further improvement for deeper architecture on Citeseer.
